title: Estimated latent line states reduce false boundary signals unevenly
statement: Across six conditional-independence mixtures, exact base-layout shuffles rejected all 30 books per setting, whereas a fitted two-state predictive null rejected 1–12 of 30. A correctly sized four-state fit reduced the four-state case from 12 to 3 rejections. All methods detected the single strong planted transition in 30 of 30 independent books.
check: Before using a fitted null for manuscript edges, preregister how the state count and training pages are chosen and replicate the calibration at higher Monte Carlo resolution over weak transitions, unseen page-emission shifts and nonrandom gaps. Require supported test cells, report inter-model disagreement, and verify the training/evaluation separation on independent historical texts with known controls.
protocol:
# P-L2-034 fitted latent line controls

Freeze the ordered last-by-first pair list (y,n) × (q,o,ch,d) and mapping
to 15 joint synthetic start-class × end-class categories with one extra
start and one extra end class. Each generated category has three
different whole-word names. Adjacent scored boundaries share the same
whole word. For every test book use T = sum((O-E)^2/(E+1)) for the eight
selected counts. Expected counts E multiply observed endpoint marginals
inside fixed groups (page, paragraph-first flag, exact line token count,
literal word position), weighting each pair of neighboring cells by its
number of eligible boundaries. Keep E fixed under exact shuffles. Compute
it afresh for predictive replicates using the same statistic and layout.

Six pages of 36 lines, four initial probe slots per line, only truly
adjacent target positions after those slots are scored. Exact widths 8,
12 or 16 unless fixed at 12. Every fourth line is marked paragraph-first.
Unknown or absent words are barriers and cannot move. Require 30 movable
nonconstant cells and 30 movable boundaries for an exact shuffle, 30
eligible edges and 30 base movable cells for the shared predictive
statistic, at least 30 total expected selected events and positive support
for every edge. A numerically inert null is reported separately. Use 39
draws per one-sided test (tie counts against rejection), p <= .05.

Thirty independent fit and test synthetic books per setting, paired
between methods. Generator seed 54201+10000*scenario+2*replica and
the next seed for held evaluation. Predeclare training EM orders K=1/2/4,
three starts, up to 35 iterations and .5 counts smoothing. Model 15 joint
categories by source slot role and fit word inventories without using
scored evaluation targets. Fit page-level uncertainty as five training-page
bootstrap fits for K=2, two restarts each. Use one refit per replicated
book and infer held line responsibilities from its observed first four
slots only. Compare exact base-layout whole-word shuffles, exact shuffles
within those cells plus the probe-only posterior modal state, plug-in
K=1/2/4 predictive simulation, K=2 plug-in with probe-based page prior, and
K=2 page-bootstrap mixture. Oracle exact conditioning uses true simulated
states only. Predictive simulations jointly sample each word's first/last
category and give it an independent alias. Held-out evaluation target
words are not inputs to the posterior responsibilities or parameter fit.

Eight controls: a one-state independent baseline; fixed-width two-state
mixture; variable widths with missing at random; four latent states;
page-specific mixture weights; page-specific emission shifts; missingness
depending on word category; and a planted start-to-previous-end effect
applied independently to about 55% of within-line target boundaries in
training and evaluation, absent from all fitted models. Correlation of
first/last categories within words is present across all emissions.
Compare validity as rejections per independent book with uncertainty,
and separately report valid/unsupported/inert status.

For the three predeclared historical pairs, form equally sized pseudo-
books from each fit/evaluation stream using the same variable-width
schedule, independent of words. These are synthetic lines, not original
typesetting. Use four fixed initial-letter classes (vowels aeiou, stops
bcdgkptq, sonorants lmnr, other consonants fhsjvwxyz), with nonletters as
other; terminal y proxy is aeiou and n proxy is nstm, remaining end
letters class other. Historical original-order outcomes are descriptive.
Also create six known-negative permutations of the exact historical target
word inventories within each observed base cell. These share material
and are not independent books. In both historical arms, training comes
from a separate author. No Voynich text or secret allocation is used.

Implementation note: predictive replicates store only the joint category
because the three equally possible aliases give exactly the same T.
Whole-word aliases are maintained in the exact shuffler. No threshold or
design was adjusted after the two-case operational smoke check.

external_streams.design: One independently authored fit/evaluation work pair per language; no reciprocal duplication.

analysis: The 210 independent known-negative books include 30 exchangeable and 180 latent-mixed trials. Exact shuffling is calibrated by construction under its own exchangeable null, not under latent mixtures that break exchangeability.

K=2 plug-in versus the five-fit K=2 bootstrap gives 8/30 versus 4/30 on shifted page emissions and 6/30 versus 3/30 on nonrandom gaps. It still gives 9/30 on the four-state control. These are paired comparisons on 30 trials per case.

One-state synthetic exchangeability generated 1–3 rejections per method. All 1,920 synthetic tests cleared support gates. The 30/30 strong-transition result is sensitivity for one effect size only. Thirty books give broad uncertainty intervals and 39 replicates give p-values on a .025 grid.

Six pseudo-book permutations per historical evaluation stream reuse the same source, and are not independent historical replications. Every method gave 0/6 rejections on the Latin and English exact-layout controls. On Spanish controls, six methods gave 1/6 and the K=2 plug-in gave 0/6.

The original-order historical p-values are descriptive. English shows .025–.075 across methods, Spanish .025–.125, and Latin .55–.725. Synthetic line breaks and unknown language mechanisms limit interpretation. No Voynich text or hidden allocations entered any fit or test.
Independent assertions checked exact word inventories, invariant expected counts, and direct edge reconstruction for 80 base and oracle-conditioned shuffle draws.

"""Layout residual statistic and full-word permutation controls."""
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

DRAWS = 39
PROBE = 4
PAGE_LINES = 36
PAGES = 6
WIDTH = 20
START_GROUPS = 5
END_GROUPS = 3
VOCAB_CORRELATES = 3
ALPHA = 0.05


@dataclass
class Layout:
    pages: np.ndarray
    widths: np.ndarray
    paragraph: np.ndarray
    roles: np.ndarray


def layout(rng, variable):
    rows = PAGE_LINES * PAGES
    pages = np.repeat(np.arange(PAGES), PAGE_LINES)
    widths = rng.choice((8, 12, 16), rows) if variable else np.full(rows, 12)
    paragraph = np.arange(rows) % 4 == 0
    slot = np.arange(WIDTH)[None, :]
    roles = np.where(slot < widths[:, None], 1, -1)
    roles[:, 0] = 0
    roles[np.arange(rows), widths - 1] = 2
    return Layout(pages, widths, paragraph, roles)


def group_label(labels):
    _, reverse = np.unique(labels, axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    return reverse


def exposure(whole_words, layout, categories_lookup):
    """Compile tested target positions, exact-layout cells and adjacency boundaries."""
    known = (whole_words >= 0) & (np.arange(WIDTH)[None, :] >= PROBE)
    rows, cols = np.nonzero(known)
    if not len(rows):
        return None
    cells = group_label(np.stack((layout.pages[rows], layout.widths[rows],
                                  layout.paragraph[rows], cols), axis=1))
    graph = np.full(whole_words.shape, -1, dtype=np.int32)
    graph[rows, cols] = np.arange(len(rows))
    left, right = graph[:, :-1], graph[:, 1:]
    valid = (left >= 0) & (right >= 0)
    a, b = left[valid], right[valid]
    if len(a) < 30:
        return None
    n = int(cells.max() + 1)
    edges, counts = np.unique(n * cells[a] + cells[b], return_counts=True)
    retained = whole_words[rows, cols].copy()
    return {"rows": rows, "cols": cols, "cells": cells, "n": n,
            "left": a, "right": b, "edge_rows": edges // n, "edge_cols": edges % n,
            "edge_counts": counts, "categories": categories_lookup, "observed": retained,
            "cell_sizes": np.bincount(cells, minlength=n)}


def disparity(words, support):
    categories = support["categories"][words]
    first = categories // END_GROUPS
    last = categories % END_GROUPS
    cells = support["cells"]
    n = support["n"]
    lcount = np.bincount(END_GROUPS * cells + last, minlength=n * END_GROUPS).reshape(n, END_GROUPS)
    rcount = np.bincount(START_GROUPS * cells + first, minlength=n * START_GROUPS).reshape(n, START_GROUPS)
    sizes = support["cell_sizes"][:, None]
    left_rate = (lcount / sizes)[support["edge_rows"], :2]
    right_rate = (rcount / sizes)[support["edge_cols"], :4]
    expected = (left_rate.T * support["edge_counts"]) @ right_rate
    a, b = support["left"], support["right"]
    observed = np.bincount(START_GROUPS * last[a] + first[b],
                           minlength=END_GROUPS * START_GROUPS).reshape(END_GROUPS, START_GROUPS)[:2, :4]
    score = float(np.sum((observed - expected) ** 2 / (expected + 1)))
    return score, observed, expected


def shuffle_groups(labels, words, support):
    order = np.argsort(labels, kind="stable")
    slicing = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(labels[order])) + 1
    strata = [x for x in np.split(order, slicing) if len(x) > 1 and np.ptp(words[x]) > 0]
    changed = np.zeros(len(words), dtype=bool)
    for x in strata:
        changed[x] = True
    edges = int(np.count_nonzero(changed[support["left"]] | changed[support["right"]]))
    return strata, edges


def exact_shuffle(words, strata, rng, out=None):
    result = words.copy() if out is None else out
    for s in strata:
        result[s] = rng.permutation(words[s])
    return result


def summarize_draws(observed, values, movement=None):
    floated = np.array(values)
    details = {"movable": movement}
    if not len(floated):
        return details | {"status": "unsupported", "p": None}
    moved = bool(np.any(np.abs(floated - observed) > 1e-12))
    p = (1 + np.count_nonzero(floated >= observed - 1e-12)) / (1 + len(floated))
    return details | {"status": "valid" if moved else "inert",
                      "p": float(p) if moved else None,
                      "null_mean": float(floated.mean()),
                      "null_range": [float(floated.min()), float(floated.max())]}


def permutation_test(words, support, score, seed, optional_states=None):
    labels = support["cells"]
    if optional_states is not None:
        states = optional_states[support["rows"]]
        labels = group_label(np.stack((labels, states), axis=1))
    strata, edges = shuffle_groups(labels, words, support)
    motion = {"cells": len(strata), "eligible_boundaries": edges}
    if min(len(strata), edges) < 30:
        return summarize_draws(score, [], motion)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    permuted = words.copy()
    null = [disparity(exact_shuffle(words, strata, rng, permuted), support)[0] for _ in range(DRAWS)]
    return summarize_draws(score, null, motion)

"""Categorical line mixtures with held-apart, probe-only state inference."""

import numpy as np
from scipy.special import logsumexp


ROLE_COUNT = 3
WORD_COUNT = 15
PSEUDOCOUNT = 0.5


def _counts(table, roles):
    table = np.asarray(table)
    roles = np.asarray(roles)
    if table.ndim != 2 or roles.shape != table.shape:
        raise ValueError("table and roles must be aligned two-dimensional arrays")
    if table.dtype.kind not in "iu" or roles.dtype.kind not in "iu":
        raise ValueError("table and roles must contain integer IDs")
    if np.any((table < -1) | (table >= WORD_COUNT)):
        raise ValueError("word IDs must be -1 (missing) or 0 through 14")
    if np.any((roles < -1) | (roles >= ROLE_COUNT)):
        raise ValueError("role IDs must be -1 (absent) or 0 through 2")
    rows, slots = np.where(table >= 0)
    if np.any(roles[rows, slots] < 0):
        raise ValueError("observed words require a valid role")
    counts = np.zeros((len(table), ROLE_COUNT * WORD_COUNT))
    codes = roles[rows, slots] * WORD_COUNT + table[rows, slots]
    np.add.at(counts, (rows, codes), 1)
    return counts


def _probabilities(counts):
    return counts / counts.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)


def _page_groups(pages, line_count):
    ids = np.asarray(pages)
    if ids.shape != (line_count,):
        raise ValueError("page IDs must contain one entry per line")
    labels, groups = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True)
    return len(labels), groups


def _log_emission(counts, distributions):
    flat = distributions.reshape(len(distributions), ROLE_COUNT * WORD_COUNT)
    return counts @ np.log(flat).T


def _responsibilities(log_joint):
    normalizer = logsumexp(log_joint, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.exp(log_joint - normalizer), float(normalizer.sum())


def fit(table, roles, state_count, seed, *, pages=None, repeats=3, iterations=35):
    """Fit one book-wide mixture with independent categorical slots within roles.

    The fixed .5 pseudocount corresponds to a symmetric Dirichlet MAP prior.
    Page IDs describe the fit sample. They do not alter the book-wide fit.
    """
    counts = _counts(table, roles)
    observed_lines = np.flatnonzero(counts.sum(axis=1))
    if not len(observed_lines):
        raise ValueError("mixture fitting requires at least one observed word")
    if state_count < 1 or repeats < 1 or iterations < 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid state count, restart count, or iteration count")
    page_count = None if pages is None else _page_groups(pages, len(counts))[0]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    pooled = _probabilities(
        counts.sum(axis=0).reshape(ROLE_COUNT, WORD_COUNT) + PSEUDOCOUNT
    )
    best = None
    restarts = []
    for restart in range(repeats):
        prototype_ids = rng.choice(
            observed_lines, size=state_count, replace=len(observed_lines) < state_count
        )
        prototypes = counts[prototype_ids].reshape(state_count, ROLE_COUNT, WORD_COUNT)
        distributions = _probabilities(prototypes + PSEUDOCOUNT + 4 * pooled)
        weights = np.full(state_count, 1 / state_count)
        history = []
        for iteration in range(iterations + 1):
            log_joint = _log_emission(counts, distributions) + np.log(weights)
            responsibilities, log_likelihood = _responsibilities(log_joint)
            objective = log_likelihood + PSEUDOCOUNT * (
                np.log(weights).sum() + np.log(distributions).sum()
            )
            history.append(float(objective))
            if iteration == iterations:
                break
            weights = _probabilities(responsibilities.sum(axis=0) + PSEUDOCOUNT)
            expected = (responsibilities.T @ counts).reshape(
                state_count, ROLE_COUNT, WORD_COUNT
            )
            distributions = _probabilities(expected + PSEUDOCOUNT)

        restarts.append(float(history[-1]))
        if best is None or history[-1] > best["objective"]:
            best = {
                "weights": weights,
                "distributions": distributions,
                "objective": history[-1],
                "objective_history": history,
                "log_likelihood": log_likelihood,
                "responsibilities": responsibilities,
                "best_restart": restart,
            }

    best.update({
        "restart_objectives": restarts,
        "state_count": state_count,
        "iterations": iterations,
        "repeats": repeats,
        "training_pages": page_count,
        "training_lines": len(counts),
        "training_observed_tokens": int(counts.sum()),
    })
    return best


def posterior(table, roles, model, page_ids=None, page_strength=8.0):
    """Infer states from the supplied probe slots.

    If page IDs are supplied, each line's prior combines global weights with
    the global-prior responsibilities of other observed probe lines on its
    page. This leave-one-line-out shrinkage does not reuse its own probe.
    """
    counts = _counts(table, roles)
    base_prior = np.asarray(model["weights"])
    distributions = np.asarray(model["distributions"])
    emission = _log_emission(counts, distributions)
    pooled, _ = _responsibilities(emission + np.log(base_prior))
    if page_ids is None:
        return pooled
    if not np.isfinite(page_strength) or page_strength <= 0:
        raise ValueError("page_strength must be finite and strictly positive")

    group_count, groups = _page_groups(page_ids, len(counts))
    observed = counts.sum(axis=1) > 0
    mass = np.zeros((group_count, len(base_prior)))
    np.add.at(mass, groups[observed], pooled[observed])
    other_probe_mass = np.maximum(mass[groups] - observed[:, None] * pooled, 0)
    page_priors = _probabilities(page_strength * base_prior + other_probe_mass)
    result, _ = _responsibilities(emission + np.log(page_priors))
    return result

"""Fitted line-state nulls for frozen edge counts, using no manuscript inputs."""
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import numpy as np

import layout_test as lt
from mixture import fit, posterior

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES = {
    "exchangeable": (1, False, "none"),
    "mixture_fixed": (2, False, "none"),
    "mixture_missing": (2, True, "mcar"),
    "four_states": (4, True, "none"),
    "page_weights": (2, True, "page-weights"),
    "page_emissions": (2, True, "page-emissions"),
    "nonrandom_gaps": (2, True, "mnar"),
    "planted_transitions": (2, True, "transition"),
}
TRIALS = 30
CATEGORIES = np.repeat(np.arange(15), lt.VOCAB_CORRELATES)


def generate_model(state_count):
    starts = np.ones((state_count, lt.START_GROUPS), dtype=float)
    tails = np.ones((state_count, lt.END_GROUPS), dtype=float)
    for k in range(state_count):
        starts[k, k % 4] += 9
        starts[k, (k + 1) % 4] += 3
        tails[k, k % 2] += 8
        tails[k, 2] += 1
    within_word = np.ones((lt.START_GROUPS, lt.END_GROUPS))
    within_word[np.arange(lt.START_GROUPS), np.arange(lt.START_GROUPS) % lt.END_GROUPS] = 2.3
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(starts, tails):
        role = []
        for i in range(3):
            aa, bb = a.copy(), b.copy()
            if i == 0:
                aa[0] *= 1.4
            if i == 2:
                bb[0] *= 1.4
            weight = aa[:, None] * bb[None, :] * within_word
            role.append((weight / weight.sum()).ravel())
        out.append(role)
    return np.array(out)


def row_draw(probs, rng):
    cumulative = probs.cumsum(axis=-1)
    cumulative[..., -1] = 1.0
    return (cumulative < rng.random(probs.shape[:-1])[..., None]).sum(axis=-1)


def synth(seed, state_count, variable, variant):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    design = lt.layout(rng, variable)
    default = generate_model(state_count)
    pages = design.pages
    n = len(pages)
    if variant == "page-weights":
        topic = rng.dirichlet(np.full(state_count, 0.45), size=lt.PAGES)
    else:
        topic = np.full((lt.PAGES, state_count), 1 / state_count)
    latent = row_draw(topic[pages], rng)
    word_laws = default[None, ...] * np.ones((lt.PAGES, 1, 1, 1))
    if variant == "page-emissions":
        word_laws *= np.exp(rng.normal(0, 0.65, (lt.PAGES, 1, 1, 15)))
        word_laws /= word_laws.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    probabilities = word_laws[pages[:, None], latent[:, None], np.maximum(design.roles, 0)]
    word_class = row_draw(probabilities, rng)
    if variant == "transition":
        for k in range(lt.PROBE + 1, lt.WIDTH):
            change = (rng.random(n) < 0.55) & (k < design.widths)
            start = word_class[change, k - 1] % lt.END_GROUPS
            joint = probabilities[change, k].reshape(-1, lt.START_GROUPS, lt.END_GROUPS)
            tail_probabilities = joint[np.arange(len(start)), start]
            tail_probabilities /= tail_probabilities.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
            new_end = row_draw(tail_probabilities, rng)
            word_class[change, k] = start * lt.END_GROUPS + new_end
    words = word_class * lt.VOCAB_CORRELATES + rng.integers(0, lt.VOCAB_CORRELATES, design.roles.shape)
    words[design.roles < 0] = -1
    if variant == "mcar":
        words[rng.random(words.shape) < 0.12] = -1
    if variant == "mnar":
        missing_probability = np.where((word_class // lt.END_GROUPS) == 0, 0.32, 0.06)
        words[rng.random(words.shape) < missing_probability] = -1
    return words, design, latent


def to_categories(words, lookup):
    return np.where(words < 0, -1, lookup[np.maximum(words, 0)])


def learned(training, layout, seed):
    models = {k: fit(training, layout.roles, k, seed + k * 11, pages=layout.pages)
              for k in (1, 2, 4)}
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 540)
    bootstrap = []
    for i in range(5):
        selections = rng.integers(0, lt.PAGES, size=lt.PAGES)
        members = np.concatenate([np.flatnonzero(layout.pages == page) for page in selections])
        boot = fit(training[members], layout.roles[members], 2, seed + 600 + i,
                   pages=layout.pages, repeats=2, iterations=35)
        bootstrap.append(boot)
    return models, bootstrap


def simulate_edges(responsibilities, model, design, support, rng):
    latent = row_draw(responsibilities, rng)
    rows, cols = support["rows"], support["cols"]
    laws = model["distributions"][latent[rows], design.roles[rows, cols]]
    return row_draw(laws, rng)


def prediction_test(score, available, design, support, seed, replicas):
    if not available:
        return lt.summarize_draws(score, [])
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    expectations = support | {"categories": np.arange(15)}
    values = []
    for r in range(lt.DRAWS):
        responsibilities, model = replicas[int(rng.integers(len(replicas)))] if len(replicas) > 1 else replicas[0]
        fit_sample = simulate_edges(responsibilities, model, design, support, rng)
        values.append(lt.disparity(fit_sample, expectations)[0])
    return lt.summarize_draws(score, values)


def evaluate_book(train_models, words, design, lookup, seed, true_states=None):
    models, bootstrap = train_models
    support = lt.exposure(words, design, lookup)
    if support is None:
        return {"status": "unsupported_layout"}
    observed_words = support["observed"]
    score, observed, expectation = lt.disparity(observed_words, support)
    strata, movement = lt.shuffle_groups(support["cells"], observed_words, support)
    eligible = min(len(strata), movement) >= 30 and expectation.sum() >= 30 and expectation.min() > 0
    probes = to_categories(words[:, :], lookup)
    probes[:, lt.PROBE:] = -1
    global_states = {k: posterior(probes, design.roles, model) for k, model in models.items()}
    page = posterior(probes, design.roles, models[2], design.pages)
    out = {
        "observed": observed.tolist(), "expected": expectation.tolist(), "score": score,
        "base_movable_cells": len(strata), "base_movable_edges": movement,
        "eligible_edges": len(support["left"]), "observed_probes": int(np.count_nonzero(probes >= 0)),
        "mean_max_state_posterior": float(np.mean(page.max(axis=1))),
        "missing_target_slots": int(np.count_nonzero((words[:, lt.PROBE:] < 0)
                                                  & (design.roles[:, lt.PROBE:] >= 0))),
        "test": {},
    }
    probes_draws = [(posterior(probes, design.roles, model, design.pages), model) for model in bootstrap]
    for k, model in models.items():
        out["test"][f"predict_full_k{k}"] = prediction_test(
            score, eligible, design, support, seed + 30 + k, [(global_states[k], model)]
        )
    out["test"]["predict_page_k2"] = prediction_test(
        score, eligible, design, support, seed + 40, [(page, models[2])]
    )
    out["test"]["predict_bootstrap_k2"] = prediction_test(
        score, eligible, design, support, seed + 50, probes_draws
    )
    out["test"]["shuffle_base"] = (
        lt.permutation_test(observed_words, support, score, seed + 10)
        if eligible else lt.summarize_draws(score, [])
    )
    out["test"]["shuffle_modal"] = (
        lt.permutation_test(observed_words, support, score, seed + 11, page.argmax(axis=1))
        if eligible else lt.summarize_draws(score, [])
    )
    if true_states is not None:
        out["test"]["shuffle_oracle"] = (
            lt.permutation_test(observed_words, support, score, seed + 12, true_states)
            if eligible else lt.summarize_draws(score, [])
        )
    out["status"] = "tested_layout" if eligible else "unsupported_layout"
    return out


def summaries(rows):
    names = sorted({k for row in rows for k in row.get("test", {})})
    result = {}
    for name in names:
        data = [row.get("test", {}).get(name, {"status": "unsupported", "p": None}) for row in rows]
        n = len(data)
        hits = sum(x["p"] is not None and x["p"] <= lt.ALPHA for x in data)
        phat = hits / n
        z = 1.959963984540054
        scale = 1 + z*z/n
        center = (phat + z*z/(2*n)) / scale
        width = z * math.sqrt(phat*(1-phat)/n + z*z/(4*n*n)) / scale
        result[name] = {"rejections": hits, "cases": n,
                        "status_count": dict(Counter(d["status"] for d in data)),
                        "wilson_95_all_cases": [max(0.0, center-width), min(1.0, center+width)]}
    return result


def run_synthetic(limit, requested):
    results = {}
    for i, (name, (state_count, variable, variant)) in enumerate(CASES.items()):
        if requested and name not in requested:
            continue
        trials = []
        for j in range(limit):
            seed = 54201 + 10000 * i + 2 * j
            w_train, l_train, _ = synth(seed, state_count, variable, variant)
            w_test, l_test, true = synth(seed + 1, state_count, variable, variant)
            fitted = learned(to_categories(w_train, CATEGORIES), l_train, seed + 900)
            trial = evaluate_book(fitted, w_test, l_test, CATEGORIES, seed + 5000, true)
            trial["fit_seed"] = seed
            trial["fit_diagnostics"] = {
                "train_k_objective": {str(k): m["objective"] for k, m in fitted[0].items()},
                "bootstrap_weights": [m["weights"].tolist() for m in fitted[1]],
            }
            trials.append(trial)
        summary = summaries(trials)
        results[name] = {"description": [state_count, variable, variant], "trials": trials, "summary": summary}
        print(name, {k: v["rejections"] for k, v in summary.items()}, flush=True)
        if not requested and limit == TRIALS:
            (WORK / f"synthetic-progress-{i+1}.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,separators=(",", ":"))+"\n")
    return results


def source_class(word):
    start = next((i for i, group in enumerate(("aeiou", "bcdgkptq", "lmnr", "fhsjvwxyz"))
                  if word[0] in group), 4)
    end = 0 if word[-1] in "aeiou" else 1 if word[-1] in "nstm" else 2
    return start * lt.END_GROUPS + end


def historical_words(words, seed, lexicon):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    design = lt.layout(rng, True)
    occupied = design.roles >= 0
    assert int(occupied.sum()) <= len(words)
    observed = np.full(design.roles.shape, -1, dtype=np.int32)
    observed[occupied] = [lexicon[w] for w in words[:int(occupied.sum())]]
    return observed, design


def run_external():
    stream = json.loads((WORK / "external-streams.json").read_text())
    data = []
    for i, pair in enumerate(stream["pairs"]):
        words = []
        for key in ("fit", "evaluation"):
            spec = stream["works"][pair[key]]
            raw = (WORK / spec["file"]).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == spec["sha256"]
            words.append(raw.decode().split())
        lex = sorted(set(words[0]) | set(words[1]))
        ids = {w: j for j, w in enumerate(lex)}
        cat = np.array([source_class(w) for w in lex], dtype=np.int32)
        seed = 99001 + i * 1000
        training, source_layout = historical_words(words[0], seed, ids)
        target, design = historical_words(words[1], seed + 1, ids)
        fitted = learned(to_categories(training, cat), source_layout, seed + 900)
        observed = evaluate_book(fitted, target, design, cat, seed + 300)
        support = lt.exposure(target, design, cat)
        strata, _ = lt.shuffle_groups(support["cells"], support["observed"], support)
        nullptr = []
        for j in range(6):
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1040 + j)
            candidate = target.copy()
            shuffled = lt.exact_shuffle(support["observed"], strata, rng)
            candidate[support["rows"], support["cols"]] = shuffled
            nullptr.append(evaluate_book(fitted, candidate, design, cat, seed + 1200 + j))
        data.append(pair | {"observational": observed, "exchangeable": nullptr,
                            "exchangeable_summary": summaries(nullptr), "case_seed": seed})
        print("external",pair["id"],flush=True)
    return data


def main():
    smoke = "--smoke" in sys.argv
    group = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--group")+1].split(",") if "--group" in sys.argv else []
    results = run_synthetic(2 if smoke else TRIALS, group) if "--external-only" not in sys.argv else {}
    external = run_external() if not smoke and not group else []
    name = "smoke" if smoke else ("-".join(group) if group else "all")
    (WORK / f"latent-results-{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"synthetic": results, "external": external, "numpy": np.__version__},
        separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Validate exact-cell margins and original adjacency against direct enumeration."""
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np

import layout_test as lt
from calibrate import CATEGORIES, synth

checks = 0
for seed in (1037, 5581, 6157, 20837):
    word_ids, layout, state = synth(seed,2,True,"mcar")
    support = lt.exposure(word_ids,layout,CATEGORIES)
    words = support["observed"]
    cells = support["cells"]
    expectation = lt.disparity(words,support)[2]
    obs = lt.disparity(words,support)[1]
    counted = Counter()
    for i in range(len(layout.pages)):
        for j in range(lt.PROBE,layout.widths[i]-1):
            left,right = word_ids[i,j:j+2]
            if min(left,right)<0:
                continue
            tail = CATEGORIES[left] % lt.END_GROUPS
            lead = CATEGORIES[right] // lt.END_GROUPS
            if tail < 2 and lead < 4:
                counted[tail,lead] += 1
    exact = [[counted[i,j] for j in range(4)] for i in range(2)]
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(obs,exact)
    oracle_groups = lt.group_label(np.stack((cells,state[support["rows"]]),axis=1))
    for groups in (cells,oracle_groups):
        slots, _ = lt.shuffle_groups(groups,words,support)
        target = Counter(zip(groups,words))
        rng=np.random.default_rng(seed+31)
        for draw in range(10):
            result=lt.exact_shuffle(words,slots,rng)
            assert Counter(zip(groups,result))==target
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(lt.disparity(result,support)[2],expectation)
            checks += 1
print(f"{checks} draws preserve exact word marginals, and direct counts preserve all adjacency barriers")

"""Materialize capped historical word streams from verified body extracts."""

from argparse import ArgumentParser
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from vs.refcorpus import normalize


CAP = 10000
PAIRS = (
    ("latin", "latin_bede", "latin_kempis"),
    ("english", "english_gower", "english_chaucer"),
    ("spanish", "spanish_lucanor", "spanish_buenamor"),
)


def digest(data):
    return sha256(data).hexdigest()


def checked(path, expected):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if digest(data) != expected:
        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected digest: {path}")
    return data


def extended_ruiz(raw):
    start = re.search(r"^892 Dueñas,", raw, re.M).start()
    tail = raw[start:]
    end = re.search(r"^1230 Medio caño", tail, re.M).start()
    source = re.sub(r"\{\d+\}|\[[A-Z]\]", "", tail[:end])
    stanzas = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"^\s*([0-9]+)\s+\S", source, re.M)]
    if stanzas != list(range(892, 1230)):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected Juan Ruiz stanza sequence")
    lines = [line for line in source.splitlines() if not line.strip().isupper()]
    if any(re.match(r"\s*\[\d+\]", line) for line in lines):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected editorial note in Juan Ruiz")
    return normalize("\n".join(lines), "spanish")


def prepare(archive, output):
    source_manifest = archive / "controls/manifest.json"
    entries = json.loads(source_manifest.read_text())["works"]
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths = output / "external-text"
    paths.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    works = {}
    for _, fit, evaluate in PAIRS:
        for name in (fit, evaluate):
            entry = entries[name]
            raw = checked(archive / entry["raw_file"], entry["raw_sha256"])
            base = checked(archive / entry["file"], entry["sha256"])
            full = base.decode("ascii")
            extraction = entry["body_boundary"]
            title = entry["title"]
            if name == "spanish_buenamor":
                full = extended_ruiz(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
                if not full.startswith(base.decode("ascii")):
                    raise ValueError("Extended Juan Ruiz text differs in existing body span")
                title = "Libro de Buen Amor, stanzas 892–1229"
                extraction = (
                    "From 892 Dueñas to immediately before 1230 Medio caño. "
                    "Verify all 338 stanza numbers after removing page braces. "
                    "Remove bracketed capital-letter markers and standalone uppercase headings."
                )
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+)*", full):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid normalized stream: {name}")
            words = full.split()
            selected = " ".join(words[:CAP]).encode("ascii")
            if len(words) < 8000:
                raise ValueError(f"Fewer than 8000 words: {name}")
            rel = f"external-text/{name}.txt"
            (output / rel).write_bytes(selected)
            editorial = entry["source_notes"]
            works[name] = {
                "author": entry["author"],
                "title": title,
                "language": entry["language"],
                "date": entry["date"],
                "genre": entry["genre"],
                "edition": entry["edition"],
                "source_url": entry["url"],
                "catalog_url": entry.get("catalog_url"),
                "source_notes": editorial,
                "raw_archived_path": entry["raw_file"],
                "raw_sha256": entry["raw_sha256"],
                "previous_body_sha256": entry["sha256"],
                "body_extraction": extraction,
                "full_normalized_body_sha256": digest(full.encode("ascii")),
                "full_normalized_body_words": len(words),
                "selection": f"First {min(CAP, len(words))} normalized word tokens, in source order.",
                "file": rel,
                "sha256": digest(selected),
                "words": min(CAP, len(words)),
            }
    pair_entries = [
        {"id": lang, "fit": fit, "evaluation": evaluate} for lang, fit, evaluate in PAIRS
    ]
    manifest = {
        "works": works,
        "pairs": pair_entries,
        "word_stream": "ASCII lowercase alphabetic tokens separated by single spaces; no terminal newline.",
        "boundary_note": "Word order is retained; original line, sentence and page breaks are not represented.",
        "design": "One independently authored fit/evaluation work pair per language; no reciprocal duplication.",
        "prior_body_manifest_sha256": digest(source_manifest.read_bytes()),
        "prior_body_cleaner_sha256": digest((archive / "prepare-controls.py").read_bytes()),
    }
    (output / "external-streams.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
    )
    for key, info in works.items():
        print(key, info["words"], info["full_normalized_body_words"], info["sha256"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("padding_workdir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    prepare(args.padding_workdir, args.output)
